summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF LOUISIANA.
attorneys: Mr. Thomas J. Durant and Mr. Charles W. Hornor for plaintiffs in error., Mr. Charles B. Singleton, Mr. Samuel Shellabarger and Mr. J. M. Wilson for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Waite
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Waite

delivered the opinion of the court.

This case is in all its material facts precisely'like that of the same plaintiffs in error against Benner, just decided, and is dismissed for the reasons stated in that opinion.
